header.name: Swaraj Singh
subtitle: Cybersecurity engineer and open-source contributor bridging security operations, governance & risk, and security engineering. Combines threat hunting, alert triage, and incident escalation with practical control mapping (ISO 27001, NIST CSF 2.0, ITGC/SOX), enterprise vulnerability management (Qualys VMDR, OpenVAS), WAF rule tuning, and engineering reusable tools for detection, evidence collection, and remediation.

entries.title: SOC Analyst Intern
bullets: Supported threat hunting with endpoint, firewall, and proxy telemetry mapped to MITRE ATT&CK. Enriched indicators with OSINT and automated initial triage to deliver actionable escalation context.
Performed vulnerability assessments using automated scans and CVSS prioritization to assess exposure and document remediation recommendations.
Reviewed NIST SP 800-53 and ISO 27001 logging, access isolation, and disaster recovery controls; delivered a comprehensive GRC gap analysis.
Investigated identity anomalies, reviewed role-based access permissions (RBAC) to enforce least privilege, logged incident timelines, and tracked remediation.

entries.title: Product Development Intern
bullets: Built role-based web access controls and authentication workflows to simplify administrative onboarding and enforce least privilege.
Led application threat modeling with PASTA and STRIDE; evaluated defenses against OWASP Top 10 risks and configured WAF inspection rules.
Documented technical governance controls, incident handling procedures, and audit trail verification for compliance reviews.

entries.title: Project Trainee
bullets: Automated satellite imagery processing for flood detection and documented the analytical architecture and data processing workflows.

sections.label: Selected Projects

entries.title: Greyfield
entries.metadata: Security operations · OCI, Cowrie, MITRE ATT&CK, threat intelligence
bullets: Deployed a cloud honeypot for SSH and Telnet research. Analyzed 1,728 sessions from 128 source IPs in Aug-Sep 2026 and published sanitized findings mapped to nine ATT&CK techniques.

entries.title: KubeSentinel
entries.metadata: Security engineering · Docker, Kubernetes, Falco, Elastic, detection rules
bullets: Built a Kubernetes lab for workload hardening and runtime detection. Engineered Falco telemetry rules in Elastic and validated five controlled security scenarios.

entries.title: TraceIR
entries.metadata: Security operations · Digital forensics, incident timelines, evidence integrity
bullets: Built an investigation workflow that normalizes security events into timelines and validates evidence provenance and cryptographic integrity across four synthetic cases.

entries.title: Vendor Assurance Desk
entries.metadata: Governance and risk · Third-party risk, CISO Assistant, ISO 27001
bullets: Built a synthetic vendor due-diligence workflow, recorded three evidence-linked findings in CISO Assistant, exported a risk register, and recommended an onboarding hold.

entries.title: Apex Capital GRC
entries.metadata: Governance and risk · Security governance & IR plan, NIST CSF 2.0, ISO 27001
bullets: Designed a security and incident-response plan for a fictional financial services firm. Mapped eight risks to proposed controls, playbooks, and validation criteria.
